title: IgG4-related disease
diseaseDescription: Bounded cross-organ immune-mechanism candidate: selected human B-cell/plasmablast, IL-4-positive Tfh and CD4 cytotoxic T-cell findings, with culture collagen production and a salivary tissue branch. No complete organ-specific model, proven causal loop, pathogenic-IgG4-to-fibrosis claim, diagnostic validation or therapy efficacy coverage. All primary reports were inspected at abstract level only; independent domain review and calibration are pending.
releaseNote: Local abstract-level candidate from seven primary reports. Culture collagen stimulation remains separate from correlative tissue/blood findings. Three qualifying findings retained; no whole-loop causation or independent replication established. No therapies curated; numerical appraisals are provisional automatic rules, not calibration. Agent source checks are not independent human approval.

entities.label: B cells
entities.description: Circulating CD19-positive B-cell populations; culture findings concern cells from IgG4-RD patients.

entities.label: Plasmablasts
entities.description: Circulating plasmablasts characterized by flow cytometry, repertoire sequencing and selected culture assays; phenotypes vary between studies.

entities.label: Plasma cells / ASCs
entities.description: Antibody-secreting cells; tissue observations here concern IgG4-positive cells or MUM1-positive cells as specified by each claim.

entities.label: IL-4+ BATF+ Tfh cells
entities.description: The IL-4-expressing follicular helper T-cell subset measured in human secondary and tertiary lymphoid organs.

entities.label: CD4+ cytotoxic T cells
entities.description: Clonally expanded cytotoxic CD4 T lymphocytes in selected IgG4-RD blood and tissue samples; not all helper T cells.

entities.label: IgG4
entities.description: Immunoglobulin G subclass 4; cell expression, serum concentration and antibody pathogenicity are distinct assertions.

entities.label: IL-4
entities.description: Interleukin-4; measured in the cited Tfh subset, without establishing causal sufficiency for IgG4-RD.

entities.label: TGF-beta1
entities.description: Transforming growth factor beta 1; expression by lesional CD4 cytotoxic cells is retained without inferring a fibroblast-response edge.

entities.label: IL-1 beta
entities.description: Interleukin-1 beta expressed by the cited lesional CD4 cytotoxic cells.

entities.label: PDGF-B
entities.description: Platelet-derived growth factor B; assessed in B-cell cultures and as PDGF beta expression in salivary tissue.

entities.label: Human fibroblast cultures
entities.description: Fibroblasts cocultured with patient-derived circulating B-cell subsets; not a universal in-vivo fibroblast identity.

entities.label: Salivary FAP+ fibroblasts
entities.description: FAP-positive fibroblasts identified histologically in IgG4-related sialadenitis; distinct from culture fibroblasts.

entities.label: Collagen / ECM production
entities.description: Collagen production in the cited B-cell/fibroblast coculture assay; not a measured whole-organ fibrosis outcome.

entities.label: Active IgG4-RD
entities.description: Study-defined active disease, flare and remission in selected human cohorts; not a diagnostic test or validated universal activity biomarker.

claims.text: Circulating oligoclonal plasmablasts were expanded in the reported active IgG4-RD cohort; their decline after B-cell depletion correlated with remission.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.

claims.text: Circulating plasmablasts were elevated in the reported active, untreated, biopsy-proven multi-organ IgG4-RD cohort.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Shared authors and institutions with the earlier plasmablast report; independent replication is not established.

claims.text: Elevated circulating plasmablasts in active IgG4-RD were also observed with normal serum IgG4, limiting any assumption that activity requires an elevated serum IgG4 level.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Qualification of serum-IgG4 dependence, not evidence against the plasmablast/activity association.

claims.text: Active IgG4-RD patients separated into B-cell endotypes with differing plasmablast, memory, naive and regulatory B-cell profiles, qualifying a uniform plasmablast-dominant model.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Exploratory cluster definitions do not establish universal endotypes or prospectively validated treatment prediction.

claims.text: Expanded circulating plasmablasts in the reported active IgG4-RD cohort were largely IgG4-positive.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Largely IgG4-positive does not mean all plasmablasts are IgG4-positive; antibody pathogenicity remains unestablished.

claims.text: Most follicular helper T cells in the examined IgG4-RD secondary and tertiary lymphoid organs expressed IL-4.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.

claims.text: The proportion of IL-4/BATF- or IL-4/CXCR5-positive CD4 T cells correlated with tissue IgG4 plasma-cell numbers.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Correlative tissue evidence does not demonstrate the required help interaction or class-switching sufficiency.

claims.text: The proportion of the examined IL-4-positive CD4 T-cell subsets correlated with plasma IgG4 levels.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.

claims.text: The reported T-cell proportion correlation did not extend to total plasma levels of other immunoglobulin isotypes; this is an isotype-specific qualification, not proof of causal IgG4 class switching.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.

claims.text: Clinical remission after rituximab-mediated B-cell depletion was associated with reduced disease-associated CD4 cytotoxic T-cell numbers.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Treatment-associated change does not prove direct B-cell antigen presentation or direct drug targeting of these T cells.

claims.text: Lesional clonally expanded CD4 cytotoxic T cells expressed TGF-beta1.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Expression does not establish a downstream fibroblast effect; no T-cell-to-fibrosis causal edge is curated.

claims.text: Lesional clonally expanded CD4 cytotoxic T cells expressed IL-1 beta.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Expression does not establish a downstream fibroblast effect; no T-cell-to-fibrosis causal edge is curated.

claims.text: Patient-derived B cells produced PDGF-B in the reported human B-cell/fibroblast experiments.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; detailed controls, effect sizes and blocking experiments are not independently appraised.
Coculture effects do not establish whole-organ fibrosis, clinical causation or efficacy of a therapy.

claims.text: B cells from IgG4-RD patients stimulated collagen production by fibroblasts in the reported cocultures.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; detailed controls, effect sizes and blocking experiments are not independently appraised.
Coculture effects do not establish whole-organ fibrosis, clinical causation or efficacy of a therapy.

claims.text: Patient plasmablasts expressed gene sets implicated in fibroblast activation and proliferation; this transcriptional finding is not a direct causal activation edge.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; detailed controls, effect sizes and blocking experiments are not independently appraised.
Coculture effects do not establish whole-organ fibrosis, clinical causation or efficacy of a therapy.
Transcriptional enrichment alone does not establish functional activation.

claims.text: MUM1-positive plasma cells expressed PDGF beta in the examined IgG4-related sialadenitis sections.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Salivary tissue finding only; MUM1 positivity does not establish that every cell expressed IgG4.

claims.text: In the examined IgG4-related sialadenitis tissue, 90.4% of MUM1-positive plasma cells were within 20 micrometres of FAP-positive fibroblasts.
limitations: Abstract-only inspection; cohort overlap and methods/quality are not independently verified.
Association or expression does not establish disease causation or generality across organs.
Spatial proximity is not proof of PDGF-mediated activation; abstract-level tissue results are not transferred to other organs.
